follow_ups.detail: The closure audit sent this follow-up to this node. The criteria files are outside this node's parallel_write_scopes, so they were read but not edited. Two changes are needed. (1) timeline-three-rounds says 「三张缩略图都显示真实图片」 and 「每张卡片有提示词摘要」. After B-01, the expanded card shows its large image in place of the thumbnail, and its full prompt in place of the summary. This matches the design's §7.1 sketch, and the design document wins over derived criteria (cross-phase-protocols F). Suggested wording: collapsed cards show a real thumbnail and a prompt summary; the expanded card shows the large image and the full prompt instead. (2) attempt-selected-actions / timeline-three-rounds should add a minimum rendered size for 大图: at least 192px (2× the 96px thumbnail) or 60vh, whichever is smaller. Enforced by e2e IMAGE_FLOOR.
follow_ups.not_a_product_decision: The design already fixes both points: the §7.1 sketch shows the expanded card as label, then 大图, then 完整提示词; D-74 sets the upper bound. The floor is a quality bar asked for by the verify reviewers, not a new user-visible behaviour.

If wanted, it goes to interactive bootstrap as a product question.

fixes_applied.fix: The expanded done card no longer repeats itself above the large image. It drops the header thumbnail, because the large image replaces it (the §7.1 sketch draws the expanded card with no thumbnail). It hides the header prompt summary, because the full prompt sits right under the image. It puts 「第 N 次 · HH:MM」 and 「宽×高 · N 步」 on one line. The collapsed cards, and the failed, cancelled and missing-file cards, are unchanged (D-73, D-84). Inside the expanded area the gaps shrink from 12px to 8px, and an empty action-hint line takes no space. The pane still caps the image by the space left in the timeline (D-74's 60vh bound is kept), but the cap now has a floor of 192px, twice the thumbnail. When the card cannot fit with the image at the floor, revealExpanded keeps the image's top and both actions in view, and only the header line scrolls away. Measured at 900×700 in the harness: the expanded image went from 147px to 234px (1024×1024 PNG), and the card's non-image height went from 245px to 158px.
